Next, please. Boarding pass and passport?
Here you are. Excuse me, could you tell me where gate C12 is?
C12? They have changed it. Your flight leaves from C7 now. Check the screens, not the boarding pass.
Oh. And my bag hasn't arrived yet. Is that normal?
Belt four, it is slow today. Have you been to Athens before?
I've been here once. I came in July with my family and it was forty degrees.
Forty. That is Athens in July. Do you need anything else?
Yes, where can I change money? I mean, where is the currency exchange?
Ground floor, next to the pharmacy. It is just around the corner from the shuttle stop.
The thing that goes to the metro? We have already booked a taxi, actually.
Even better. Enjoy Greece, and the Acropolis is the one landmark you cannot miss.
Thank you so much. I've never asked for help in English before. That was easier than I thought.

So, my first time flying alone. I have done it twice now and I still get nervous at the same place, which is customs. Last summer I flew to Lisbon to see my cousins. I got to the airport really early, and then the flight was overbooked, so they put me on a later one with a layover in Madrid. Three hours in Madrid on my own. I have never been so bored in my life. But here is the thing I learned: I asked somebody. I said, could you tell me where gate B22 is, and a woman walked me halfway there. Since that day I always ask. I have not missed a flight yet.

Good afternoon, and welcome to Athens International Airport. Passengers arriving on flight TP eight one four from Lisbon, please proceed to baggage reclaim belt four. Passengers who need to change money will find the currency exchange desk on the ground floor, next to the pharmacy. The shuttle to the metro station leaves from exit three every fifteen minutes. Please note that gate numbers for connecting flights have changed today, so check the departure screens and not your boarding pass. Thank you, and enjoy your stay in Greece.
